podcast: Rec Tech: the Recruiting Technology Podcast

f1458d8408.q: What is Dahlia Reach and how does the cost per hire model work?
f1458d8408.a: Dahlia Reach is a new cost per hire job advertising solution launched by Dahlia, representing the first cost per hire model in the industry. Companies pay only when they get a hire rather than for volume, with published rates broken out into 15 different job categories regardless of location or company size.

a20039776b.q: Why does Indeed have quality issues with high application volume?
a20039776b.a: Indeed's volume-based pricing model rewards them for delivering high volume through cost per click and cost per applicant metrics. This creates misaligned incentives because their revenue goals are at complete odds with the goals of both companies and job seekers, causing them to prioritize volume over quality.

ae1a8a7972.q: What problem does SonicJobs CareerGPT solve for job seekers on career sites?
ae1a8a7972.a: CareerGPT addresses the problem that 90% of candidates landing on a career site cannot find the job they are looking for or get answers to their questions, leaving them unable to start an application. The AI chatbot allows candidates to search using natural language and refine results with multiple conversational turns.

d004102010.q: What engagement metrics does SonicJobs CareerGPT deliver compared to keyword search?
d004102010.a: 60% of candidates who search on CareerGPT start and apply, which is six times higher than typical keyword search conversion rates. Candidates average five messages per conversation, actively refining their searches rather than typing one search and leaving.

6f301f51aa.q: How does RecruitingAds.com turn job listings into videos using AI?
6f301f51aa.a: RecruitingAds.com converts job URLs into branded videos using a combination of AI and real employee content. The platform includes custom branding setup with brand guidelines, logos, and colors to ensure on-brand output, and uses image-to-video AI capabilities to transform still photos from past photoshoots into video content.

8fbc8136db.q: What measurable outcomes does Ribbon AI interviewer deliver for hiring organizations?
8fbc8136db.a: Ribbon reports an 18% increase in retention when utilizing its AI interviewer platform and saves 5 to 10 hours per week for organizations. Candidate satisfaction reaches 94-95%, with most interviews occurring between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. when candidates can represent themselves most effectively.
